QUOTE: "High-level part (`ret & 0xFF80`): the module identity. It is passed to `mbedtls_high_level_strerr`. - Low-level part (`ret & ~0xFF80`): the specific error." and "If both parts are present, they are joined with `" : "`, provided there is room."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer explains the code splits into high-level (module) and low-level parts, and that strerror joins both with " : " when both are present.
